FIELDS.NAME: Precision Auto Care
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Lead Inspector, Precision Auto Care, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Precision Auto Care is a full-service auto repair and maintenance shop specializing in routine services for private passenger vehicles. Our operations include oil changes, tire rotations, brake inspections, and light mechanical repairs, all designed to ensure the safe and efficient performance of our customers' vehicles. We also operate a body shop that provides cosmetic repairs and paintwork, utilizing modern equipment and certified technicians to guarantee quality. Adhering to all environmental regulations, we have implemented robust waste disposal practices and maintain a controlled environment to manage hazards. Our team is committed to continuous training and compliance with industry standards, ensuring a high level of service in a secure, well-maintained facility. Located in a suburban area with low crime rates, we prioritize customer satisfaction through appointment-based services and efficient workflow management.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 03/12/2023, Cause: Accidental damage during a vehicle service, Amount: $10,000, Status: Closed; Loss Date: 06/24/2023, Cause: Theft of tools and equipment, Amount: $15,000, Status: Open.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-rated safe, Class B, for secure storage of sensitive materials and cash.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing and a watchperson during non-operating hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Precision Auto Care adheres to all environmental regulations and has implemented robust waste disposal practices, ensuring that we do not store, treat, discharge, apply, dispose, or transport hazardous materials in our operations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Precision Auto Care sponsors local athletic teams as part of our community engagement initiatives. We believe in supporting local sports to promote teamwork and healthy living.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The project manager is responsible for checking and maintaining records of these certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions for fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crime connected to this or any other property associated with the applicant.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Precision Auto Care has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. We have maintained continuous coverage without any interruptions.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Precision Auto Care does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our staff consists of directly employed technicians, ensuring consistent quality and service standards.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Precision Auto Care carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and protect both employees and the business.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Precision Auto Care also owns and operates Precision Auto Accessories, LLC. This subsidiary focuses on automotive accessories and complements our primary auto repair services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Precision Auto Care does not currently have any other insurance policies with this company. All coverage is maintained under the existing policy number provided.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Precision Auto Care is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our focus is solely on auto repair and maintenance services for private passenger vehicles.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Precision Auto Care does not rent or loan equipment to others. All equipment is exclusively used for our in-house services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Precision Auto Care has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, ensuring a stable financial background.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Precision Auto Care does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or hazardous chemicals in our operations, as we adhere strictly to safety and environmental regulations. Our focus is on routine auto maintenance and repairs in a controlled environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Precision Auto Care does not have any catastrophe exposure that would affect our operations or insurance coverage. Our focus is on routine maintenance and repairs, minimizing the risk of significant liability.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Precision Auto Care has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain strong hiring practices and compliance standards to ensure a safe and respectful work environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Precision Auto Care does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. We maintain compliance with fire safety regulations and conduct regular inspections to ensure safety standards are met.
